business_summary: A curated coffee subscription service that matches home brewers and WFH professionals with fresh-roasted coffee bags from small-batch roasters using a personalization quiz.
stated_claims: Matches you with fresh roasted bags from small roasters

relevant_tags.why: Core purchase model of the advertiser.
The service uses a quiz to match users to specific coffees.
Coffee beans are a premium pantry staple.
Coffee is frequently purchased alongside premium grocery items.
Target audience includes home brewers who use kitchenware.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Advertiser requires a matching quiz to get started

note_signals.why: Pantrygood's values-driven, natural pantry shoppers are highly aligned with small-roaster, high-quality coffee.
Kitchenly's subscription-friendly, food-interested audience is ideal for a coffee subscription.
Cloudfoot's tech-adjacent urban professional audience strongly overlaps with the 'WFH folks' target demographic.
Strandlab's audience is already highly receptive to and familiar with quiz-based personalization flows.
Pop & Sip's premium beverage and wellness/grocery crossover buyers are a strong fit for high-end coffee.

gate_reason: The product, price point, target audience, and business model are clearly stated and easy to align with existing publishers.
missing_info: Shipping costs and whether shipping is included in the $15-25 range
Whether whole bean, ground, or both options are available
clarifying_questions: Do you offer both whole bean and ground coffee options?
Is shipping free, or is there an additional flat rate per bag?
What is the default shipping frequency (e.g., weekly, bi-weekly, monthly)?
